reviews.title: Works!
reviews.comment: Worked perfectly for me, just make sure you buy the right mic for the right model. I see allot of reviews who accidentally bought the wrong mic for the wrong model. My Razer sharks have been dormant for a couple years because my mic stopped working. I recently came across them while cleaning up the closet and wanted to test them out again because the quality was good on these headphones. Alas the mic still didn't work no matter how much I fiddled with it. Came upon this replacement option for the mic and ordered it in hopes that it would fix the issue, and it did!

reviews.author: Amrie

reviews.title: Perfect mic replacement for Blackshark V2 Pro(2020)
reviews.comment: Lost the original pop filter to my headset earlier this week and decided I needed a new one along with an extra microphone just in case. The pop filters they include are smaller than the original, same quality, but they fit more snug so it doesn't fall off as easily. I tested the microphones, and the quality is honestly the same as the original. I didn't notice a difference in how I sound and plus it fit perfectly into my headphones without any of the issues I saw listed on other products. A lot of negative reviews I saw on this product alone are from those who own the newer 2023 version of the Blackshark V2 Pro, so please make sure you know what version you have before purchasing. This product is practically identical to the OEM in terms of design and functionality, so its perfect if you have the (2020) Blackshark V2 Pro like I do.
reviews.author: Javi Del

reviews.title: This worked great for me! Everyone can hear me now when I game!
reviews.comment: I've recently purchased the LEFXMOPHY Blackshark V2 Mic, and I'm really impressed with its performance. The installation was incredibly easy—just plug it into the compatible headset, and it's ready to go. The audio quality is outstanding for both gaming and video calls, with crisp, clear sound and excellent noise cancellation. The flexible design allows for easy adjustments to find the perfect position. Overall, it's a great upgrade that enhanced my communication experience, and I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a reliable mic replacement.
